Read stored objects by ref

```sh
goback [global flags] object <command>
```

## object list

List all objects

```sh
goback [global flags] object list
```

## object get

Get a single object

```sh
goback [global flags] object get <ref> <file>
```

## object count

Count all objects

```sh
goback [global flags] object count
```
